title: Completed successor-field run
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $src,dst$ be distinct work-tape indices, let $copy$ be a Boolean, and let $d$ be a configuration of the successor-field machine. Let $s$ be absent or a state index less than $n$. Suppose $d$ is in the tag state and the source tape, starting at its head position, contains the optional-state encoding of $s$. After as many steps as the length of that encoding, the machine reaches the configuration obtained by advancing from the tag state to the unary phase, with the unary encoding of $s$ copied to the destination tape exactly when $s$ is present and copying is enabled, and with the state set to done carrying whether $s$ is present.
hypotheses_covered: $d$ is a configuration of the successor-field machine
$s$ is absent or a state index less than $n$
the source tape contains the optional-state encoding of $s$ from its head position
